dedupe_keys.name: consolidation of massive medical emergency events with heterogeneous situational context data sources

description: The implemented system uses multidimensional database modelling to consolidate emergency occurrences and responses with weather, epidemic, traffic, demographic and public-event context. A Portuguese EMS case demonstrates retrieval of structures suitable for spatiotemporal analysis despite incomplete and heterogeneous source records. This is a source-established preparation component for emergency-response assessment, not a general database platform or a release of confidential emergency records. The related DAPI tool performs response-inefficiency analysis as a separate implemented resource. Code, schemas and a deployed service endpoint are not independently identified. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
